title: The localization at one element is the quotient of the polynomial ring by $rx-1$
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\in R$, $R_r$ the localization of $R$ at $\{1,r,r^2,\dots\}$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], and $R[x]$ the polynomial ring over $R$ in one variable $x$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Let $\lambda:R[x]\to R_r$ be the homomorphism of $R$-algebras with $\lambda(x)=1/r$. Then $\lambda$ is surjective and its kernel is the principal ideal $(rx-1)R[x]$; so $\lambda$ induces an isomorphism of $R$-algebras $R[x]/(rx-1)\cong R_r$.
